evidence.source: Academia Sinica, International Computer Chinese Character and Variant Database
evidence.field: Character evolution, script categories, and graphic interpretation
evidence.text: The 先 record groups oracle-bone, bronze, Chu-slip, and small-seal forms, identifies a bronze example as 集成02812, and interprets the ancient form as a person below with a foot above, expressing going ahead of others. The page does not provide a complete lineage into modern 先.
evidence.title: 漢字「先」：字形演變

evidence.source: Luo Kun, 殷墟卜辞中的“先”与“失”
evidence.field: Oracle graph identification and Shang uses
evidence.text: The paper distinguishes the graph read as 先, analyzed as 止 plus 人 and used for precedence, from a similar graph whose proposed readings include 失, 侁/姺, or a polity/name. It reports Shang examples for temporal or ritual-order precedence, including 先祖 (合集38731), 先酒 (合集28272), and 先岁 (合集25615), and examples for going ahead or leading in hunting and military contexts, including 合集4068, 28333, and 7283. These examples are dated broadly by oracle-bone corpus context; their relative semantic chronology is not established. The paper calls competing interpretations of the similar graph provisional; it does not establish corruption in 先.
evidence.kind: scholarly paleographic article reporting inscription examples
evidence.title: 殷墟卜辞中的“先”与“失”

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, 異體字字典
evidence.field: Received 說文 analysis and listed senses
evidence.text: The entry reports the 大徐本 說文 analysis 从几、从之 and the 段注本 analysis 从儿、之, both glossed 前進也. It lists senses including leading, precedence in time or order, deceased elders, ancient/former, and introducing. Its cited quotations do not establish a complete chronology of these senses.
evidence.title: [A00271] 先 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.field: File description, label, source references, and reuse terms
evidence.text: The exact file description identifies 先-seal.svg as a vector depiction of 先 in Shuowen seal-script style, names character-data sources including Sinica and Chinese Etymology, and links to an original SVG. It describes the image as a public-domain picture of ancient script; attribution is not required but appreciated. This is a modern digital redraw, not an artifact photograph.
evidence.title: File:先-seal.svg

evidence.text: The inspected Commons description page links its original SVG at https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/d/dd/%E5%85%88-seal.svg. The web tool could not open the upload URL, so the pixels were not visually inspected during this research.
evidence.kind: image URL provenance and access limitation
evidence.title: File:先-seal.svg

evidence.source: Unicode Consortium, Unihan Data for U+5148
evidence.text: The official character-specific URL for U+5148 was attempted but inaccessible in this session. The supplied local Unihan row records kMandarin 先 = xiān; that local row is not external webpage evidence. No phonetic component is proposed for 先.
evidence.kind: official data page access failure with local-row provenance limit
evidence.title: Unihan Data for U+5148

search_audit.outcome: Search surfaced institutional paleographic and dictionary pages, Luo Kun’s focused study, and the Commons candidate description. These pages were inspected; the ACC-s06218 page open returned a cache error.

search_audit.outcome: Search and page inspection verified the exact 先-seal.svg description, original SVG listing, stated label, and public-domain terms. ACC-s06218 and the Shuowen radical page did not open directly.

search_audit.query: 先 甲骨文 先 失 羅坤 殷墟卜辭
search_audit.outcome: Opened the article and checked its reported oracle-bone examples, readings, and distinctions between 先 and the disputed similar graph.

search_audit.query: Academia Sinica 先 字形演變 人 足 先
search_audit.outcome: Opened the character-specific evolution record. It gives script categories, a bronze inscription citation, and a broad person-and-foot interpretation.
The direct original SVG URL was established from the inspected Commons description page, but its direct open failed.
Reconfirmed the exact file description, original file listing, redraw provenance, and public-domain statement.

gaps: The selected seal-style glyph is a modern redraw. Its pixels could not be opened in this session; use it only as a source-described Shuowen seal-script form, not as a verified artifact image.
No exact artifact-level dates for the cited Shang oracle-bone examples were available; they are dated broadly by corpus context.
The Academia Sinica record does not establish a complete form lineage from its early categories into modern 先.

The Shang precedence and going-ahead/leading uses are attested broadly in the same corpus period, but the evidence does not establish which came first or every semantic link to later senses such as former/previous.
The similar-looking graph discussed as 失, 侁/姺, or a name remains disputed; this is a separate identification issue and does not establish corruption in 先.

The official Unihan character-specific record for U+5148 remained inaccessible. Local reading data gives xiān but is not external character-page evidence and does not establish an ancient sound relationship.
No bulk extract is recommended: character-specific sources suffice, and both repeatable editorial need and permission for a broader extract were not established together.

limitations.text: No eligible early-script image was selected: the oracle-style candidates named in the acquisition failure record returned HTTP 404 and are unavailable for this run. The selected seal-style candidate is a modern redraw and its pixels could not be opened here, so it cannot serve as an image of a Shang artifact or verify the proposed early component shapes.
